summary.text: Deborah Aylward is a Republican state representative from Merrimack 5 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Deborah Aylward's tenure in the New Hampshire House began in 2022, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2023-2024 session she served on the Municipal and County Government Committee.
